Root.description:
Groups all parts of the scroll area.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: overflowEdgeThreshold
props.type: number | Partial<{ xStart: number; xEnd: number; yStart: number; yEnd: number }>
props.description:
The threshold in pixels that must be passed before the overflow edge attributes are applied.
Accepts a single number for all edges or an object to configure them individually.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-has-overflow-x
dataAttributes.description: Present when the scroll area content is wider than the viewport.

dataAttributes.name: data-has-overflow-y
dataAttributes.description: Present when the scroll area content is taller than the viewport.

dataAttributes.name: data-overflow-x-end
dataAttributes.description: Present when there is overflow on the horizontal end side.

dataAttributes.name: data-overflow-x-start
dataAttributes.description: Present when there is overflow on the horizontal start side.

dataAttributes.name: data-overflow-y-end
dataAttributes.description: Present when there is overflow on the vertical end side.

dataAttributes.name: data-overflow-y-start
dataAttributes.description: Present when there is overflow on the vertical start side.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrolling
dataAttributes.description: Present when the user scrolls inside the scroll area.

additionalTypes.name: Root.State
